en.title: Supreme Court opens the door for Trump's mass voter purges — but not before midterms, experts say

en.title: Jeffrey Donaldson could face more than 10 years in jail for child sexual abuse, court told
en.summary: Jeffrey Donaldson, former leader of Northern Ireland's Democratic Unionist party, faces potential imprisonment exceeding 10 years after being convicted of 18 sexual abuse counts including rape against two women. Prosecutors cited the age difference between Donaldson and his victims as an aggravating factor.
